f1.quote: screened 38,326 Nb-Mo-Ta-V-W compositions. Each elemental concentration was varied from 2.5 to 40 at.% in 2.5 at.% steps

f2.quote: They selected Nb15Mo2.5Ta40V40W2.5 (at.%) for its minimum VEC combined with relatively high predicted modulus

f3.quote: prepared it by arc melting under argon

f4.quote: The designed alloy was tested in the as-cast state. Uniaxial compression was performed at room temperature and a quasi-static strain rate of 5 × 10^-4 s^-1

f5.quote: The designed alloy retained a single-phase BCC structure

f6.quote: Reducing VEC was proposed to promote intrinsic shear instability and lower the Peierls–Nabarro barrier, thereby increasing dislocation mobility and shear plasticity

f7.quote: The resulting development of dislocation slip delays brittle cracking and supports work hardening

f8.quote: was predicted to have greatly improved intrinsic ductility

f10.quote: sacrificing only a limited amount of elastic modulus/strength
